featured_reviews.name: pramod pachhapur
featured_reviews.review_text:
Horrible experience. Absolutely no professionalism.

We visited the store on 08.05.2026 and were assisted by Mr. Aziz in purchasing three products. During the sales process, Mr. Aziz made several commitments and repeatedly assured us that he would personally follow up with the concerned team to ensure that the Diwan was delivered at the earliest. His repeated statements such as, "Main try karta hoon, Diwan aapko jaldi aa jayega" and "I will continuously follow up with them" gave us confidence to proceed with the purchase.

While two of the products were delivered on time, the third product, a Diwan, was scheduled for delivery on 29.05.2026.

On 20.05.2026, I contacted Mr. Aziz to check whether the Diwan had been shipped and requested him to help ensure delivery on or before 29.05.2026. However, he neither answered my calls nor responded to my messages. Later, I learned through his message that he would be on leave for the next 15 days due to personal reasons. He shared the contact number of his colleague, Mr. Swarup.

Upon speaking with Mr. Swarup, I was informed that the Diwan would not be delivered on 29.05.2026 due to a quality-check issue from their end. I was supposed to travel out of town on 29.05.2026, and this delay caused significant inconvenience. What was even more disappointing was the casual manner in which the matter was handled, with the response simply being, "Diwan deliver nahi hoga aaj."

After several follow-ups and repeated requests, the Diwan was finally delivered on 04.06.2026, forcing me to reschedule my plans.

The issues did not end there. Upon delivery, I was informed by the delivery personnel that a carpenter would visit the same evening to assemble the Diwan. However, no one arrived, and there was no communication regarding the delay. Eventually, I had to arrange and pay for my own carpenter to complete the assembly.

Overall, this was a highly disappointing experience marked by unfulfilled commitments, poor communication, lack of accountability, and inadequate customer service. I would not recommend this store to anyone.
